page.overview:
Who is Clarabelle?

is Caduceus' moorbounder. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Clarabelle was the youngest and smallest of the three moorbounders purchased by the Mighty Nein.

Clarabelle acted the most like a kitten, such as when Caduceus tried to get it to sit and it instead gave him a big lick up the side of his face.

Clarabelle was raised by Zorth, a goblin who trained moorbounders for a living in Asarius, the City of Beasts, in Xhorhas. She was bonded to and trained by Caduceus.
